note: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Every headline, figure and URL here is invented to exercise the pipeline offline. None of it is real news. URLs use real outlet domains only so the source-trust filter can be demonstrated; the paths do not exist.

items.title: Microsoft to add data center capacity in three new regions as Azure AI demand grows
items.summary: Microsoft said it will open Azure data center capacity in three new regions over the next year, citing demand for AI workloads. The company did not disclose the investment size.

items.title: AWS launches new tools for building AI agents for enterprise customers
items.summary: Amazon Web Services launched a set of developer tools for building and monitoring AI agents, aimed at enterprise customers already on its Bedrock platform.

items.title: Analyst raises Nvidia price target, keeps Outperform rating
items.summary: A brokerage analyst raised the price target on Nvidia, citing strong data center demand, and kept an Outperform rating on the shares.

items.title: Insiders say Apple secretly launching its own coin next week!!
items.summary: Anonymous sources on social media claim Apple will launch a cryptocurrency. No evidence provided.

items.title: YouTube passes new milestone in paid subscriptions, Alphabet says
items.summary: Alphabet said YouTube's paid music and premium subscriptions crossed a new milestone, as the company leans on subscriptions to diversify beyond advertising.

items.title: Apple supplier expands iPhone assembly capacity in India
items.summary: A major Apple contract manufacturer is expanding iPhone assembly capacity in southern India as Apple diversifies production away from China.

items.title: Fed minutes show officials split on pace of further interest rate cuts
items.summary: Minutes from the latest Federal Reserve meeting showed policymakers divided on how quickly to cut interest rates further, with several citing sticky inflation.

items.title: Tesla quarterly deliveries rise, topping analyst estimates
items.summary: Tesla reported quarterly vehicle deliveries above analyst estimates, helped by demand for its refreshed models.

items.title: EU regulators open probe into cloud licensing practices of Microsoft
items.summary: The European Commission opened a formal antitrust investigation into Microsoft's cloud software licensing practices following complaints from European cloud providers.

items.title: European Commission opens investigation into Microsoft cloud licensing
items.summary: The EU's competition regulator said it is investigating whether Microsoft's licensing terms make it harder for customers to use rival cloud providers.

items.title: Washington apple growers expect record harvest this fall
items.summary: Fruit growers in Washington state expect a record apple harvest thanks to a mild growing season.

items.title: Nvidia unveils new gaming GPU lineup
items.summary: Nvidia unveiled its next gaming graphics card lineup, with availability starting next month.

items.title: 3 reasons to love Amazon stock right now
items.summary: An opinion piece arguing Amazon's advertising and cloud businesses make the stock attractive.

items.title: Alphabet announces date for third quarter earnings release
items.summary: Alphabet Inc. said it will release third quarter financial results after market close later this month, followed by a conference call.

items.title: US weighs new export curbs on advanced Nvidia AI chips to more countries
items.summary: US officials are weighing new export restrictions that would require licenses for shipments of Nvidia's most advanced AI chips to additional countries, according to people familiar with the matter. Nvidia declined to comment.

items.title: Apple Inc. files 8-K: reported a departure or appointment of directors or officers
items.summary: Form 8-K filed with the SEC. Items: 5.02. Apple disclosed that its Chief Operating Officer will step down at the end of the year and named a successor from within the company.

items.title: Apple COO to step down at year end, company names internal successor
items.summary: Apple's chief operating officer will step down at the end of the year, the company said in a filing, naming a longtime operations executive as successor.

items.title: Microsoft stock will DOUBLE by Friday, says anonymous trader
items.summary: An anonymous trader predicts Microsoft shares will double this week.

items.title: Amazon in talks to acquire AI chip startup in deal valued at about $4 billion
items.summary: Amazon is in advanced talks to acquire an AI chip design startup for about $4 billion, people familiar with the matter said, as it seeks to reduce reliance on outside chip suppliers. A deal could be announced within weeks.

items.title: Alphabet downgraded to Neutral at brokerage on search competition concerns
items.summary: A brokerage downgraded Alphabet to Neutral from Buy, saying competition from AI chat assistants could pressure search ad growth.

items.title: Microsoft beats quarterly revenue estimates as Azure growth accelerates
items.summary: Microsoft reported quarterly revenue above analyst estimates, with Azure cloud growth accelerating on AI demand. The company also raised its full-year capital spending outlook.

items.title: Microsoft quarterly revenue beats estimates as Azure growth accelerates
items.summary: Microsoft topped revenue estimates for the quarter on stronger-than-expected Azure growth.

items.title: Nvidia says it will comply with any new US export rules, sees limited near-term revenue impact
items.summary: Nvidia said it would comply with any new US export rules and expects limited impact on revenue in the current quarter, while warning longer-term restrictions could affect its international business.

items.title: Google adds new Gemini features to Workspace apps
items.summary: Google added new Gemini AI features to Gmail and Docs for business customers, available at no extra cost on some plans.
